criteria.dimension: Contingency identification and backup plan accuracy

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Revised plan still relies on the closed Route 4, or the Route 4A timing, walk, and ride details are calculated incorrectly.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Revised plan correctly switches to Route 4A but the leave-home time or arrival buffer contains an arithmetic error.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Revised plan correctly uses Route 4A with an accurate leave-home time, walk and ride duration, arrival time, and closing-time buffer.

criteria.dimension: Justification and reasoning for the revised plan

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: States the revised plan without explaining why it still works given the different stop and later departure.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Explains clearly why the revised plan still meets the booth's closing time, directly referencing the changed stop, departure, or travel time.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
